breakdown.description: An n-type semiconductor with large donor density should have electrons as the majority carriers, not holes.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly listed holes (p) as the majority carriers in an n-type semiconductor. The ground truth fixed this by removing the incorrect carrier concentrations. The agent's generated specification correctly identifies that electrons (n) should be the majority carriers, calculates the correct approximate concentrations (n ≈ 1.0×10^22 m^-3 and p ≈ 1.0×10^10 m^-3), and explicitly states that the originally listed values were physically inconsistent. This perfectly aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.
